Sentilo ACA · Odoo Integration

Official API base URL: https://aplicacions.aca.gencat.cat/sdim2/apirest/

1) Connection

Type: REST

No authentication required. Simply HTTP GET requests.

connection_params should be empty:

{}

2) Device & Sensor Configuration

Use standard Odoo models:

  • Device: mdm.measurement.device
  • Sensor: mdm.measurement.device.sensor

Each sensor must define in remotecontrol_params:

{
  "sensor": "080060-001-ANA01",
  "provider": "AFORAMENT-EST"
}

Valid providers:

  • AFORAMENT-EST
  • EMBASSAMENT-EST
  • PIEZOMETRE-EST
  • PLUVIOMETREACA-EST

3) Workflow

  1. Get Devices Plan → builds bag["sensors_plan"] items with fields:
    • sensor_id
    • device_id
    • sensor (ACA code)
    • provider
    • initial_date
  2. Get Readings Data → for each plan entry, calls: 
    /data/{provider}/{sensor}?from=DD/MM/YYYYT00:00:00&to=DD/MM/YYYYT23:59:59&limit=999999
    Then processes returned observations and upserts them into Odoo.

4) Initial Date Logic

For each sensor, initial_date is computed as:

  1. last imported reading date + 1 day
  2. otherwise: 01/01/{current_year}

5) API Response Format & Data Conversion

Typical response from ACA:

{
  "observations": [
    {
      "value": "123,4",
      "timestamp": "17/11/2025T08:31:15"
    }
  ]
}

The integration will convert:

  • value: to float (comma or dot allowed)
  • timestamp: from DD/MM/YYYYTHH:MM:SS to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

6) Database Upsert Logic

Each observation is upserted into mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading using the unique key:

{
  "sensor_id": SENSOR_ID,
  "measurement_time": TIMESTAMP
}

Stored values:

  • value
  • remotecontrol_origin_id

7) Date Window for Fetching Data

From:

{initial_date}T00:00:00

To:

{today}T23:59:59

8) Valid Providers

  • AFORAMENT-EST
  • EMBASSAMENT-EST
  • PIEZOMETRE-EST
  • PLUVIOMETREACA-EST

9) Common Errors

  • No observations returned → no data for that period or sensor
  • Invalid timestamp format → timestamp does not follow DD/MM/YYYYTHH:MM:SS
  • Float conversion error → value is not numeric
  • sensor or provider missing in remotecontrol_params → sensor skipped
  • HTTP / network errors → request failed

10) Execution Sequence

  1. Get Devices Plan (sequence 10)
  2. Get Readings Data (sequence 20)

11) Audit & Logging

After reading step completes, the system generates a JSON audit file attached to the Remote Control record. The file includes:

  • timestamp of execution
  • total upserts
  • total errors
  • per-sensor details: points found, upserts, errors, readings list, URL, etc.

An attachment is created with name:

aca_readings_fetch_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json
And a message is posted on the Remote Control: 
[ACA Readings] upserts=X errors=Y

Remote = self.remote_id SensorModel = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor'] plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or [] total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 items = [] from datetime import datetime
today_str = fields.Date.today() to_date_str = "%s/%s/%s" % (today_str[8:10], today_str[5:7], today_str[:4]) to_str = to_date_str + "T23:59:59"
for sensor_plan in plan: sensor_id = sensor_plan['sensor_id'] device_id = sensor_plan['device_id'] sensor = sensor_plan.get('sensor') provider = sensor_plan.get('provider') or "" initial_date = sensor_plan.get('initial_date') if not initial_date: initial_date = fields.Date.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
sensor_record = SensorModel.browse(sensor_id) from_str = initial_date + "T00:00:00"
url = "%s/data/%s/%s?limit=999999&from=%s&to=%s" % ( base_url.rstrip('/'), provider, sensor, from_str, to_str, )
try: resp = request_retry('GET', url, timeout=timeout) code = resp.status_code full_url = getattr(resp, 'url', url) if code < 400: payload = resp.json() or {} observations = payload.get('observations', []) if not observations: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'sensor': sensor, 'provider': provider, 'status': 200, 'url': full_url, 'error': 'No observations returned', }) continue
upserts = 0 errs = 0 readings_summary = []
for obs in observations: raw_value = obs.get('value') raw_ts = obs.get('timestamp')
try: dt_obj = datetime.strptime(raw_ts, "%d/%m/%YT%H:%M:%S") measurement_time = dt_obj.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") except: measurement_time = None
try: valf = float(str(raw_value).replace(',', '.')) except: valf = None
if measurement_time and valf is not None: try: Remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', { 'sensor_id': sensor_record.id, 'measurement_time': measurement_time, }, { 'value': valf, 'remotecontrol_origin_id': Remote.id, }, ) upserts += 1 readings_summary.append({ 'ts': measurement_time, 'value': valf, }) except Exception as e: errs += 1 readings_summary.append({ 'ts': measurement_time, 'value': valf, 'error': str(e), }) else: errs += 1 readings_summary.append({ 'ts': raw_ts, 'value': raw_value, 'error': 'Invalid measurement_time or value', })
total_upserts += upserts total_errors += errs
items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'sensor': sensor, 'provider': provider, 'status': 200, 'url': full_url, 'points_found': len(observations), 'upserts': upserts, 'errors': errs, 'readings': readings_summary, })
else: total_errors += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'sensor': sensor, 'provider': provider, 'status': code, 'url': full_url, 'error': (resp.text or '')[:400], })
except Exception as e: total_errors += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'sensor': sensor, 'provider': provider, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e), })
audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items, }
try: audit_json = json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2, default=str) b64 = base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8')) except Exception as json_error: simple_audit = { 'executed_at': str(fields.Datetime.now()), 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'error': str(json_error), } audit_json = json.dumps(simple_audit, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) b64 = base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8'))
fname = 'aca_readings_fetch_%s.json' % fields.Datetime.now().replace(':','').replace('-','').replace(' ','_')
att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id, })
Remote.message_post(body=u"[ACA Readings] upserts=%s errors=%s" % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id])
bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id
